searchText: Hi <@199561711278227457> does devnet5 have tracoor? I want to download a state https://tracoor.pectra-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/ <@199561711278227457> how expensive would be to run a single node long running devnet - mainnet distribution - small validator set - transaction fuzzer on constantly - consensus fuzzer ran sporadically. - stable mainnet versions of all clients. I assume the most expensive part is human capital here It wouldn't have caught Prysm's consensus splitting bug in devnet 5 but it would catch scarier live ones With how many validators? If it's a low enough number then the cost isn't high at all, other than some upkeep that can probably be automated Minimum possible, idea is to use it as an active differential fuzzer rather than a stress testing tool Could be long running Single relay-builder Yeah that shouldn't be too expensive and manageable, I can scope it out and text you the details. Sophia was potentially looking at a large gas limit devnet, perhaps that can be integrated here as well. Prysm fix has been deployed, so participation rate in pectra-devnet-5 should slowly move up. Here are the latest hive run results: https://hive.ethpandaops.io/pectra-devnet-5/ There are some new failures due to invalid params, it would be great if the ELs could investigate and patch the issues. In the meantime, please start planning for pectra-devnet-6. A spec page will be up by morning. There are two major changes: - We will have a EEST release, tracker found here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/issues/1108 - The `blobGasPriceUpdateFraction` will be in all genesis files, please ensure your EL can handle reading it

<@199561711278227457> how expensive would be to run a single node long running devnet

- transaction fuzzer on constantly
- consensus fuzzer ran sporadically.
- stable mainnet versions of all clients. 

I assume the most expensive part is human capital here

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Prysm fix has been deployed, so participation rate in pectra-devnet-5 should slowly move up.

Here are the latest hive run results: https://hive.ethpandaops.io/pectra-devnet-5/

There are some new failures due to invalid params, it would be great if the ELs could investigate and patch the issues. 

In the meantime, please start planning for pectra-devnet-6. A spec page will be up by morning. There are two major changes:
- We will have a EEST release, tracker found here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/issues/1108
- The `blobGasPriceUpdateFraction` will be in all genesis files, please ensure your EL can handle reading it
